premises.text: The supply chain system can be made more sustainable and efficient by replacing single-use packaging with reusable options
premises.evidence_span: we're really looking to make the supply chain system more sustainable and efficient. So we're doing that by starting off by replacing all single-use packaging.

premises.text: Retailers are the direct customers for the reusable packaging solution
premises.evidence_span: our direct customer is the retailers themselves.

premises.text: Retailers are increasingly aware of consumer dissatisfaction with single-use packaging
premises.evidence_span: retailers now are waking up to the fact that consumers are fed up with it and looking for solutions.

premises.text: The reusable shippers are designed using upcycled materials
premises.evidence_span: the first fleet of shippers that we're working with actually use upcycled materials.

premises.text: The reusable packaging solution is currently being used by 30 retailers in the U.S.
premises.evidence_span: we're working with 30 retailers in the U.S. ranging in size from small SMBs to large enterprise companies.

premises.text: The model for reusable packaging is scalable and works better with larger companies
premises.evidence_span: the model works at any size. It actually works better the bigger it is.

value.text: The supply chain can become more sustainable through the use of reusable packaging
value.evidence_span: we're really looking to make the supply chain system more sustainable and efficient.
